verdicts.evidence: Narrow-footprint false red. Without ^, any status word ENDING in a keyword becomes set aside. Recipe: ADR with `**Status**: unrejected` cited deviated; fixture .probe-5/fx/g-unrejected, measured: shipped exit 0, mutated exit 1 + "is unrejected — a set-aside decision cannot justify a deviation" (the remediation becomes absurd on top of that). The exact words stay refused (g-rejected: exit 1 + same message on both sides, measured). DOUBLE surface: compliance.js:104 computes the compliance pack's `ratified` flag with the same regex — the pack that leaves the building. Nothing sees it: the corpus honest case carries the word "accepted" (ends in no keyword), self-gate replayed on the mutant exit 0 (every status in the repository starts with accepted). Footprint: portmanteau words, unlikely but constructible — the anchor has no test on the green side.

verdicts.evidence: REALISTIC false red. Without $, a prefix is enough: `**Status**: obsoleted` — a real and common English variant — flips. Recipe: an otherwise healthy ratified ADR with status "obsoleted" cited deviated; fixture .probe-5/fx/g-obsoleted, measured: shipped exit 0 (the shipped build accepts "obsoleted" as ratified — reference behaviour, whatever one thinks of its correctness: it is THAT behaviour the net must pin), mutated exit 1 + "is obsoleted — a set-aside decision cannot justify a deviation". Exact words intact (g-rejected identical on both sides). Double surface: compliance.js:104 (the pack's ratified). Nothing sees it: no test holds a word NEIGHBOURING the keywords on the green side; self-gate replayed on the mutant exit 0, corpus "accepted".
